description: Source code for managing internationalization (i18n) commands in Mattermost, including extracting, checking, and cleaning translation strings.

methods.name: getBaseFileSrcStrings
methods.description: Reads and unmarshals the base translation strings from en.json.

methods.name: resolveSymlink
methods.description: Resolves a path if it's a symlink, otherwise returns the original path.

methods.name: extractSrcStrings
methods.description: Walks through source directories to extract translation keys from source code.

methods.name: extractCmdF
methods.description: Handles the 'extract' command logic for extracting translation strings.

methods.name: checkCmdF
methods.description: Handles the 'check' command logic for verifying translation source strings.

methods.name: addDynamicallyGeneratedStrings
methods.description: Adds predefined dynamic translation keys to the set.

methods.name: extractByFuncName
methods.description: Extracts translation keys from function calls based on function name and arguments.

methods.name: extractForConstants
methods.description: Extracts translation keys from constant declarations.

methods.name: extractFromPath
methods.description: Parses Go source files to find translation keys used in code.

methods.name: checkEmptySrcCmdF
methods.description: Checks for empty translation strings in en.json.

methods.name: countEmptyItems
methods.description: Counts and reports empty translation items.

methods.name: cleanEmptyCmdF
methods.description: Removes empty translations from translation files.

methods.name: removeEmptyTranslations
methods.description: Filters out empty translation entries from a list.

methods.name: JSONMarshal
methods.description: Encodes data into JSON with indentation and HTML escaping disabled.
